subject: Hosted API pricing - token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <sarah@cleverchat.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lopez <tom.lopez@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: Hosted API pricing - token volumes & TPS

Hi Ben / Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier - we found the demo helpful. As discussed, we wanted to give a first pass at our expected usage so you can size Hosted API pricing and advise on unit economics. High-level:

- Expected monthly token volume (combined prompts+completions): 150,000,000 - 250,000,000 tokens/month (depends on pilot vs full rollout)
- Peak TPS (inbound requests at busiest minute): ~12-15 TPS (spikes to ~20 TPS for short windows)
- Average tokens per request: ~850 (250 prompt / 600 completion)
- Target cost objective from finance: roughly $6- $10 per 1M tokens (they called this our target $/1M to evaluate vendors)
- Latency SLO: p95 generation <= 1.2s is preferred; 2s acceptable for some flows

Can you confirm the assumptions you need (prompt/completion split, steady vs burst, streaming support) and share a rough hosted pricing example at our volume (monthly cost + expected peak concurrency impact)?

Attaching our token sample and a quick spike chart from the call.

Thanks,
Sarah
Customer Success | CleverChat

Attachments: token-volume-analysis.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah@cleverchat.ai>
Cc: Tom Lopez <tom.lopez@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T18:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Hosted API pricing - token volumes & TPS

Hi Sarah / Tom - appreciate the clear numbers, that helps a lot. A couple quick clarifying questions so I can get you a clean hosted quote and unit economics: 

1) Prompt vs completion: you put ~250 / 600 on average - is that across all features or do some flows (chat vs batch summarization) skew much larger? If you can call out the % of requests that are chat (lower tokens) vs bulk summarization (higher tokens) that helps.

2) Spiky behavior: you noted 12-15 TPS normally and spikes to 20 TPS. How long are the spikes (minutes / hours)? Do spikes correlate with marketing events?

3) Target $/1M: finance target of $6- $10/1M is reasonable. For hosted API we usually express pricing in $/1M tokens for generation; optional add-ons (dedicated throughput, higher retention) change the unit cost. Is the $6- $10/1M a hard constraint for your procurement team or a guidance range?

4) Any compliance requirements (SOC2 / IP retention) that might push you toward Dedicated/private pricing?

I'll loop Marissa for an initial hosted pricing example and a simple cost projection (monthly $ at low/likely/high volume + guidance on peak capacity and recommended concurrency plan). Plan to send a short PDF quote and an example cost table.

Next step: Marissa - can you draft a 1-page hosted pricing example for Acme using 150M / 200M / 250M token tiers and note recommended concurrency/burst cushion for ~15 TPS peak?

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sarah Mills <sarah@cleverchat.ai>
Cc: Tom Lopez <tom.lopez@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Hosted API pricing - token volumes & TPS

Hi team - attaching a concise hosted pricing example and a token-cost table for the three tiers Ben mentioned. Highlights below: 

- Assumptions used: 250 prompt / 600 completion split (avg 850 tokens/request).
- Monthly tiers (example):
  * 150M tokens/month -> list price equivalent = $1,050 @ $7/1M tokens
  * 200M tokens/month -> list price equivalent = $1,600 @ $8/1M tokens
  * 250M tokens/month -> list price equivalent = $2,250 @ $9/1M tokens
- Peak TPS guidance: for sustained 12-15 TPS we recommend a hosted plan with optional burst capacity to 25 TPS for short windows. There is a small throughput surcharge for sustained >20 TPS - we modeled the quote assuming bursts only.
- Unit economics note: the numbers above are illustrative list prices; with a committed monthly volume (12-month commit) we can reduce the $/1M token rate by 10-25% depending on tier and term.
- Add-ons: streaming/low-latency SLO and longer log retention are separate line items (call out if required).

Attaching: redwood-hosted-quote-acme.pdf (1-page) and token-volume-analysis.xlsx (the sample Sarah shared, annotated).

If the finance target is $6- $10/1M, the 200M tier we show at $8/1M is the closest fit. For procurement I recommend we propose the 12-month commitment with a 10% discount target and an option to scale in month 3 if they hit higher usage.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-minute pricing review with Tom and Sarah tomorrow morning - Ben, can you coordinate?

Best,
Marissa
Director, Revenue | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-hosted-quote-acme.pdf, token-volume-analysis.xlsx
